svg.title: BamHI restriction-site cleavage
svg.desc: Schematic, not to scale. BamHI cleaves G|GATCC and CCTAG|G. Blue and gold identify the two restriction fragments, not the two strands. Both products retain complementary 5-prime GATC overhangs. Source teaching content: image_008.jpg.
svg.text: Cleavage occurs in each strand at
Cleavage creates a short complementary single-stranded overhang
